# Security policy

DeFi Checkup is read only. It never asks for a wallet connection, signature, seed phrase or private
key, and it never sends transactions. Recovery takes place in the linked official apps.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Report privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
https://github.com/Defi-checkup/deficheckup/security/advisories/new

Do not open a public issue with exploit details, secrets or wallet data. Include the affected
version or commit, affected component, impact and minimal reproduction steps using synthetic data
or a documented public third-party fixture. Never send a seed phrase, private key or your own
wallet addresses. Do not exploit other users, exhaust provider quotas or move funds to prove a bug.

## Supported versions

The latest deployed production version, https://deficheckup.com, receives security fixes. Older
deployments and forks must be updated by their operators. The maintainer will confirm receipt,
investigate privately and coordinate a fix and disclosure with the reporter. No response-time
guarantee or bounty program is offered.
